author: Angais
description:
Pixel Art Atlas · 1.4M Synthetic Sprites
	


1,409,404 synthetic game sprites with English captions, covering 6,194 training subjects. Each sprite is a native 16×16 image with a transparent background. The images were generated from text prompts with Krea 2 Turbo and a pixel art LoRA.

description:
USDCraft-10K: Simulation-Ready Articulated 3D Assets in OpenUSD
	






  
  
  
  


USDCraft-10K is a dataset of simulation-ready rigid and articulated 3D assets in OpenUSD, built
with USDCraft (Geometrically Grounded Programmatic
Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation). USDCraft has a language model write each
object as an asset program, which is compiled into an articulated USD asset with parts, joints and

author: nvidia
description:
Welcome to NVIDIA SimReady Assets
	

Welcome to NVIDIA's open-source SimReady Assets dataset!
SimReady Central brings together OEM-curated datasets like this one, helping you discover simulation-ready assets for your projects.
Interested in contributing? Visit nvidia/simready-central-library and request contributor access through the Community tab.

Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (Dev Set)
	

Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (PLE) is a benchmark of long-horizon engineering tasks built by licensed practicing engineers across 4 disciplines.
